spec_match.rationale: Showcases the flagship practical use case from the explainer: a 2D spatial mind-map where scroll-snap-type: pair ensures panning snaps to a real node rather than an empty coordinate formed by orthogonal nodes.

interactive.rationale: Provides node jump buttons, a diagonal drift stressor button, scroll-snap-type and scroll-snap-align selectors, and live Euclidean distance telemetry to all 5 nodes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Directly implements the 2D node canvas and mind-map explorer with live (scrollLeft, scrollTop) distance-to-node telemetry promised on the index page.

edge_cases.rationale: Tests both center and start alignment and demonstrates how a diagonal scroll between North-West (70, 80) and South-East (640, 500) snaps to (70, 500) under both mandatory vs Event Queue (110, 510) under pair mandatory.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/5124378896498688, the CSS Scroll Snap 1 spec, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: Probes CSS.supports('scroll-snap-type', 'pair mandatory') and validates single-element coordinate convergence.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified node jumping, diagonal drift button behavior, and distance table updates with zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Reports showcaseTelemetry assertion for the CSS.supports probe and live per-node Euclidean distance calculations.

design_system.rationale: Uses only shared CSS tokens from /public/styles.css, explicit button color/background rules, and accessible 44px controls.

accessibility.rationale: Includes nav landmark with aria-current state synchronization, role=img + aria-label on the SVG connector layer, and aria-live=polite readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Bounded scrollport and wrapping control toolbars work cleanly across narrow 360px mobile and wide desktop viewports without horizontal page overflow.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap navigation jump links/buttons inside a proper nav landmark and synchronize aria-current with the active snap target.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped the 5 node jump buttons in a <nav aria-label='Mind-map node jump controls'> and toggled aria-current='true' on the active snapped node.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide explicit focusable buttons for jumping directly to snap targets in 1D/2D scroll containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added 44px buttons for all 5 mind-map nodes plus a diagonal drift test button.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose graphical diagrams and active spatial selection via text tables and aria-live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added role=img and aria-label to the SVG edge layer plus a live Euclidean distance table.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair select elements with visible labels and 44px minimum touch targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped both select controls in <label class='ctrl'> elements with min-height: 44px.

summary: Practical 2D spatial mind-map explorer comparing pair mandatory against both mandatory across 5 connected nodes with live Euclidean distance telemetry.
